sentence: On 18 September 2026 the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved imlunestrant (Inluriyo) in combination with abemaciclib (Verzenio).
The approval is for adults with ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
The FDA also approved the Guardant360 CDx assay as a companion diagnostic to identify breast cancers with ESR1 mutations for treatment with imlunestrant and abemaciclib.
note: Search text: Guardant360 CDx companion diagnostic.

sentence: The FDA says the approval rests on the EMBER-3 trial, in which patients were randomly assigned to imlunestrant, standard endocrine therapy, or imlunestrant with abemaciclib.
note: Search text: EMBER-3 randomly assigned 1:1:1 imlunestrant, standard ET, or combination.

sentence: The FDA had approved imlunestrant alone in September 2025 for ESR1-mutated disease that had progressed after at least one line of endocrine therapy.
note: Search text: imlunestrant alone approved September 25, 2025 for ESR1-mutated disease with progression following at least one line of endocrine therapy.
